TaskDescription: Orientation/direction tuning: drifting sine-wave gratings in 24 directions (0-345 deg, 15-deg steps), 80% contrast, 10 deg diameter, 1 cycle/deg, 3 Hz (Self et al. 2016; OSF 'Details of the dataset').
Instructions: Fixate the fixation pattern near the top-left of the screen (2-deg window, else the trial was aborted)

AuthorsPreprocessing.Description: Recorded at 32.5 kHz (NeuraLynx HS-9 unity-gain head-stage, skull-screw ground); re-referenced to the average of microwires E0-E4; LFP: down-sampled to 930 Hz, 1-200 Hz 2nd-order zero-phase Butterworth band-pass, 50 Hz sine fitted and subtracted per trial; MUA: 500 Hz-5 kHz band-pass, rectified, down-sampled to 930 Hz, low-pass < 200 Hz; MUAt: threshold crossings of the band-passed signal (Self et al. 2016, Methods and S1 Fig). Released as epochs around stimulus onset.

Manufacturer: Neuralynx (HS-9 head-stage); AdTech depth electrodes with side microwires
iEEGReference: average of the (non-spiking) microwires E0-E4 of the same bundle (E5 excluded because of noise)
iEEGPlacementScheme: clinical stereotactic depth electrodes (15 AdTech electrodes, frameless stereotaxy); one electrode in visual cortex carried a microwire bundle; microwires E6 and E7 in left early visual cortex (V2/V3 by post-explantation fMRI retinotopy)
iEEGElectrodeGroups: microwire-bundle: 40-um platinum-iridium side-wires between the macro-contacts of one clinical depth electrode
